task: UNIFIED CUSTOMIZATION SUITE UI — Tekken base + wrestling mix design spec
resume_brief: Owner directive 2026-10-13: design and build the combined character customization UI. Tekken's customization menu FEEL is the base, mixed with wrestling's deeper body/attire editing, plus good ideas from other games (DOA wardrobe, TTT2 Combot). Source material: T7 (17 slot IDs, 10 save slots/char, item shop, conflict system), T6 (~20 slots, Item Moves), TTT2 (Combot cross-roster move mixing), No Mercy (6 pages, 4 attire slots, 14M+9F bodies), WMXIX (2,690 edit_data, parametric body), DOA6 (10-slot wardrobe). Read CUSTOMIZATION-RESEARCH.md and CUSTOMIZATION-FILES-INDEX.json in ~/workspace/western-heart/customization/. Deliverable: UNIFIED-UI-SPEC.md with screen-by-screen layout, menu hierarchy, unified slot system, and flow diagrams. New fighter -> customize -> moveset -> save flow. Owner wants it to FEEL like Tekken's suite with wrestling parts mixed in.
notes: UNIFIED-UI-SPEC.md written (22.7KB). All owner additions incorporated: DOA wardrobe tab, full-screen preview central pattern, complete-game/DLC philosophy, teardown art sourcing, functional behavior from real sources (T7 TKDataPatcher, T6 PSP manual, No Mercy re-docs).
